entities.name: PMID:25452766
observations: Di et al. reconstructed HIF-1-centered transcriptional networks in AML cohorts, including APL/M3, using 119 experimentally validated direct HIF-1 target genes.

The APL-associated network showed reduced adhesion-related expression and increased extracellular-matrix, motility, and invasion-related programs; the pattern reversed during ATRA-induced NB4 differentiation.
The study supports an HIF-1-linked EMT-like transcriptional association, but does not establish canonical EMT, epithelial morphology, functional invasion, or causal HIF-1 perturbation.

entities.name: Acute promyelocytic leukemia
observations: APL/M3 samples displayed an HIF-1-associated transcriptional program with EMT-like characteristics in the reported AML network analysis.

entities.name: HIF-1 network
observations: An APL-specific HIF-1-dependent subnetwork was enriched for extracellular-matrix interaction and migration-related programs, with decreased adhesion and increased motility/invasion signals.

entities.name: APL EMT-like program
observations: In computational analyses of two AML cohorts and NB4 differentiation, the HIF-1 network revealed an EMT-like gene-expression pattern in APL, but not proof of a complete epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition.
